videoDetails.title: General Assembly 2025 Mini-Recap | The Alliance for Mission & Renewal
videoDetails.shortDescription: AMR board members Sean Lucas, Joel St. Clair and Jenilyn Swett share their answers to the question “How was GA for you?” in this micro-recap. They talk about the AMR Fellowship Gathering, the women’s gathering, the treatment of Irwyn Ince, and their hope for the issues facing the PCA this year.
videoDetails.author: Alliance for Mission and Renewal
